summary: Kanzhun Limited filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules, reporting share buybacks for cancellation. From March 20 to April 15, 2026, the company repurchased over 12 million Class A ordinary shares at prices ranging from approximately $6.57 to $7.14 per share, representing less than 0.1% of existing shares each day. The buybacks are part of a capital return program, reducing share count and boosting per-share metrics. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing shows ongoing open-market repurchases; watch for pace and total authorization utilization as signals of management's view on undervaluation.
